faq.q: What is the cheapest boat for a stag weekend in Marbella 2036?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are our most affordable options, starting at €749 for 2 hours (skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT included). Both fit up to 11 guests and depart from Puerto Banús. For a half-day stag trip, budget around €2,299 for 8 hours.

faq.q: How much does the Mangusta 80 cost for a stag party?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) costs €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter. This includes a free jet ski. It’s a premium choice for a stag group wanting space, speed, and a statement boat. All drinks and snacks are included.

faq.q: What is included in the yacht charter price for a stag weekend?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees. You just need to bring your group and a good playlist.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food and drink on the yacht?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. However, our standard package already includes a generous selection of beverages and snacks. If you want a full catering service, we can arrange that on request.

faq.q: How far in advance should we book a stag yacht in Marbella for 2036?
faq.a: For peak season (June–September), book at least 4–6 weeks ahead to secure your preferred boat and time slot. Off-peak months are more flexible, but popular models like the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94 go fast. WhatsApp us to check availability.

faq.q: What is the best boat for a stag group of 10–12 people?
faq.a: For 10–12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (12 pax), Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax), or Ferretti 94 (12 pax) are excellent choices. The Mangusta 80 includes a free jet ski, which is a hit with stag groups. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Can we add extra hours or services to our stag charter?
faq.a: Yes, you can extend your charter for additional hours (subject to availability). We can also arrange a DJ, catering, water toys, or a photographer. Just let us know your requirements via WhatsApp and we’ll price it up.

faq.q: Is it cheaper to charter a yacht for a stag weekend in the off-season?
faq.a: Yes, off-season (October–May) rates are generally lower, and availability is better. However, our published prices for Astondoa 40, Azimut 39, and Mangusta 80 are fixed regardless of season. Other boats are priced on request. The weather in Marbella is mild year-round.

data.body_html:
Planning a stag weekend in Marbella for 2036? A yacht charter is the ultimate way to celebrate with your mates. This budget breakdown covers our fleet, real prices, what's included, and tips to keep costs under control. Whether you're a group of 8 or 12, we've got the numbers you need.

All our yachts depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's luxury marina. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and Spanish VAT (21%). No surprises. Let's break down the costs.

Our Stag-Friendly Fleet and Prices for 2036

We have boats to suit different group sizes and budgets. Here are the key options with fixed prices:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – from €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – same pricing as Astondoa 40.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719 minimum 4 hours (includes free jet ski).
  • Mangusta 80 (Grey) (24m, 12 pax) – same pricing, same inclusions.

For other boats like the Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94, or Canados 86, pricing is on request via WhatsApp. These are ideal for larger stag groups wanting more space and luxury.

What's Included in Every Stag Charter

No hidden extras. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper (no need for a boating licence)
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You can bring your own food and extra drinks. We can also arrange catering, a DJ, or water toys on request.

Sample Stag Weekend Budget Breakdown

Here's a realistic budget for a group of 10 mates on a half-day charter (4 hours) on the Astondoa 40:

ItemCost (€)Per Person (€)
Yacht charter (4h)€1,498€149.80
Extra drinks/food€200€20
Transport to Puerto Banús€50€5
Total€1,748€174.80

For a premium stag experience on the Mangusta 80 (4 hours, 12 pax):

ItemCost (€)Per Person (€)

Prices are for 2036 based on current rates. Confirm via WhatsApp for exact availability.

How to Save on Your Stag Yacht Charter

  • Book off-peak (October–May) for better availability and lower demand.
  • Choose a half-day (4h) instead of full day – plenty of time for swimming, drinks, and photos.
  • Split costs evenly – most boats fit 10–12 guests, bringing per-person costs down.
  • Bring your own snacks to top up the included provisions.
  • Book early – peak season slots fill 4–6 weeks ahead.

Best Stag Itineraries from Puerto Banús

All our charters start from Puerto Banús. Popular stag routes include:

  • Costa del Sol coastline – cruise past the Golden Mile, Marbella Marina, and Cabopino.
  • Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés – secluded coves for swimming and photos.
  • Estepona or Sotogrande – a longer trip for a full-day adventure.

Your skipper will tailor the route to your group's preferences. Want to anchor near a beach club? Just ask.

Frequently asked questions

What is the cheapest boat for a stag weekend in Marbella 2036?

The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are our most affordable options, starting at €749 for 2 hours (skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT included). Both fit up to 11 guests and depart from Puerto Banús. For a half-day stag trip, budget around €2,299 for 8 hours.

How much does the Mangusta 80 cost for a stag party?

The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) costs €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter. This includes a free jet ski. It’s a premium choice for a stag group wanting space, speed, and a statement boat. All drinks and snacks are included.

What is included in the yacht charter price for a stag weekend?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees. You just need to bring your group and a good playlist.

Can we bring our own food and drink on the yacht?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. However, our standard package already includes a generous selection of beverages and snacks. If you want a full catering service, we can arrange that on request.

How far in advance should we book a stag yacht in Marbella for 2036?

For peak season (June–September), book at least 4–6 weeks ahead to secure your preferred boat and time slot. Off-peak months are more flexible, but popular models like the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94 go fast. WhatsApp us to check availability.

What is the best boat for a stag group of 10–12 people?

For 10–12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (12 pax), Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax), or Ferretti 94 (12 pax) are excellent choices. The Mangusta 80 includes a free jet ski, which is a hit with stag groups. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Can we add extra hours or services to our stag charter?

Yes, you can extend your charter for additional hours (subject to availability). We can also arrange a DJ, catering, water toys, or a photographer. Just let us know your requirements via WhatsApp and we’ll price it up.

Is it cheaper to charter a yacht for a stag weekend in the off-season?

Yes, off-season (October–May) rates are generally lower, and availability is better. However, our published prices for Astondoa 40, Azimut 39, and Mangusta 80 are fixed regardless of season. Other boats are priced on request. The weather in Marbella is mild year-round.
